PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temperance_Init();

// 14 - Temperance (the Resonant). Goal: cause reactions; 3 / 6 / 15 in ARCANA_Aspect_Common.txt (spec 9).
//   Tier I Resonance lives in Stats (Catharsis +1d8, longer moods, The Two Cups). Tier II Harmony and the
//   Tier III wave are here. GENERATED by gen_emotion_alchemy.pl -- do not edit by hand.
//REGION Tables
PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temperance_Init()
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_AwakeningStatus(_S)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_AwakeningStatus(_S);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temperance_Init()
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyMood(_F, _E, _A, _O)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyMood(_F, _E, _A, _O);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temperance_Init()
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SurgeRoot(_R, _E)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SurgeRoot(_R, _E);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temperance_Init()
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Feeling(_F)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Feeling(_F);

IF
SavegameLoaded()
THEN
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_Temperance_Init();
//END_REGION

//REGION Goal: every feeling, intense emotion and Catharsis caused (The Two Cups: each one)
IF
StatusApplied(_Target, _Status, (CHARACTER)_Resonant, _)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_AwakeningStatus(_Status)
AND
HasPassive(_Resonant, "Arcana_Passive_Aspect_Temperance_Awakening", 1)
THEN
PROC_ARCANA_Aspect_Step(_Resonant, "TEMPERANCE");
//END_REGION

//REGION The Surge being cast (Harmony needs it when both emotions of a feeling are on one side)
IF
UsingSpellOnTarget((CHARACTER)_Resonant, _, _Spell, _, _, _)
AND
DB_ARCANA_CardFamily(_Spell, _Root)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_SurgeRoot(_Root, _Emotion)
THEN
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_LastSurge(_Resonant, _Emotion);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_LastSurge((CHARACTER)_Resonant, (STRING)_Emotion)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_LastSurge(_Resonant, _Old)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_LastSurge(_Resonant, _Old);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_LastSurge((CHARACTER)_Resonant, (STRING)_Emotion)
THEN
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_LastSurge(_Resonant, _Emotion);
//END_REGION

//REGION Tier II: Harmony (once per turn, the nearest other creature within 6 m of the feeling's bearer gains a mood, R39)
IF
StatusApplied((CHARACTER)_Target, _Feeling, (CHARACTER)_Resonant, _)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Feeling(_Feeling)
AND
DB_ARCANA_AspectReached(_Resonant, 2)
AND
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Harmonized(_Resonant)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Aspect_InCombat(_Resonant, _Combat)
THEN
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyClear(_Resonant);
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyConsider(_Resonant, _Target, _Combat);
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyApply(_Resonant, _Feeling);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyClear((CHARACTER)_Resonant)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyBest(_Resonant, _Cand, _Dist)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyBest(_Resonant, _Cand, _Dist);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyConsider((CHARACTER)_Resonant, (CHARACTER)_From, (GUIDSTRING)_Combat)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Aspect_InCombat(_Cand, _Combat)
AND
_Cand != _From
AND
IsDead(_Cand, 0)
AND
GetDistanceTo(_From, _Cand, _Dist)
AND
_Dist <= 6.0
THEN
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyOffer(_Resonant, _Cand, _Dist);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyOffer((CHARACTER)_Resonant, (CHARACTER)_Cand, (REAL)_Dist)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyBest(_Resonant, _Old, _OldDist)
AND
_Dist < _OldDist
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyBest(_Resonant, _Old, _OldDist);
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyBest(_Resonant, _Cand, _Dist);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyOffer((CHARACTER)_Resonant, (CHARACTER)_Cand, (REAL)_Dist)
AND
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyBest(_Resonant, _, _)
THEN
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyBest(_Resonant, _Cand, _Dist);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyApply((CHARACTER)_Resonant, (STRING)_Feeling)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyBest(_Resonant, _Cand, _)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_LastSurge(_Resonant, _Emotion)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyMood(_Feeling, _Emotion, _ForAlly, _ForFoe)
AND
IsAlly(_Resonant, _Cand, 1)
THEN
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Harmonized(_Resonant);
ApplyStatus(_Cand, _ForAlly, 42.0, 1, _Resonant);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyApply((CHARACTER)_Resonant, (STRING)_Feeling)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyBest(_Resonant, _Cand, _)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_LastSurge(_Resonant, _Emotion)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_HarmonyMood(_Feeling, _Emotion, _ForAlly, _ForFoe)
AND
IsAlly(_Resonant, _Cand, 0)
THEN
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Harmonized(_Resonant);
ApplyStatus(_Cand, _ForFoe, 42.0, 1, _Resonant);

IF
TurnStarted((CHARACTER)_Resonant)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Harmonized(_Resonant)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Harmonized(_Resonant);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Aspect_Reset((CHARACTER)_Char)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Harmonized(_Char)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Harmonized(_Char);
//END_REGION

//REGION Tier III: Emotional Overload reaches every enemy within 6 m of the target that carries a feeling (first collect, then apply)
IF
UsingSpellOnTarget((CHARACTER)_Resonant, (CHARACTER)_Target, "Target_Arcana_Created_EmotionalOverload", _, _, _)
AND
DB_ARCANA_AspectReached(_Resonant, 3)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Aspect_InCombat(_Resonant, _Combat)
THEN
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_WaveCollect(_Resonant, _Target, _Combat);
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_WaveApply(_Resonant);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_WaveCollect((CHARACTER)_Resonant, (CHARACTER)_Target, (GUIDSTRING)_Combat)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Aspect_InCombat(_Cand, _Combat)
AND
_Cand != _Target
AND
IsEnemy(_Resonant, _Cand, 1)
AND
IsDead(_Cand, 0)
AND
GetDistanceTo(_Target, _Cand, _Dist)
AND
_Dist <= 6.0
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Feeling(_Feeling)
AND
HasActiveStatus(_Cand, _Feeling, 1)
THEN
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_WavePending(_Resonant, _Cand);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_WaveApply((CHARACTER)_Resonant)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_WavePending(_Resonant, _Cand)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_Feeling(_Feeling)
AND
HasActiveStatus(_Cand, _Feeling, 1)
THEN
RemoveStatus(_Cand, _Feeling, _Resonant);

PROC
PROC_ARCANA_Resonant_WaveApply((CHARACTER)_Resonant)
AND
DB_ARCANA_Resonant_WavePending(_Resonant, _Cand)
THEN
NOT DB_ARCANA_Resonant_WavePending(_Resonant, _Cand);
ApplyStatus(_Cand, "PARALYZED", 6.0, 1, _Resonant);
//END_REGION
EXITSECTION

ENDEXITSECTION
